16 college football games are on the board: 0 live, 0 final and 16 upcoming. The desk is prioritizing story stakes over schedule lines, with attention on clean monitoring.

- Finals: 0

- Sarkisian: 'Manning' name leading to outsized criticism of Arch
- Doering, Burns switch it up for Week 6 Power Rankings' ups and downs
- Sources: UCLA QB Iamaleava out indefinitely with knee injury
- Auburn's top LB Atkins 'won't be available' vs. Georgia, says Golesh
- Vols coach Heupel won't commit yet to starting QB vs. Crimson Tide
- FSU's Mike Norvell 'pushing forward' amid job security questions
- Alabama WR Coleman-Williams unlikely to play vs. Vols, says DeBoer
- Michigan sticking with Underwood as QB1, OC Beck as playcaller

- Rankings and postseason pressure

- Market expectation versus football reality

NEWSROOM READ
- Sarkisian: 'Manning' name leading to outsized criticism of Arch: Texas coach Steve Sarkisian defended Arch Manning on Monday following the upset loss to Oklahoma, saying the "Manning" name is leading to greater scrutiny.
- Doering, Burns switch it up for Week 6 Power Rankings' ups and downs: SEC This Morning's Peter Burns and Chris Doering switch roles as they rank the five biggest positive and negative storylines from Week 6 play.
- Sources: UCLA QB Iamaleava out indefinitely with knee injury: UCLA quarterback Nico Iamaleava is out indefinitely with a knee injury, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel on Monday.
- Auburn's top LB Atkins 'won't be available' vs. Georgia, says Golesh: Auburn LB Xavier Atkins, a popular preseason All-America pick, "won't be available" for Saturday's game vs. No. 1 Georgia, according to coach Alex Golesh.
- Vols coach Heupel won't commit yet to starting QB vs. Crimson Tide: Tennessee coach Josh Heupel was noncommittal about his QB -- either freshman Faizon Brandon or sophomore George MacIntyre -- Saturday against Alabama.
